blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jollibee Foods Corp. (JFC) has identified more than 1,500 potential trade areas for expansion from 2027 to 2030, with about 71 percent outside Metro Manila. These areas would support the growth of the brands Jollibee, Mang Inasal and Chowking, which together account for nearly 90 percent of the group’s Philippine systemwide sales. READ: […]...
